limitations: Separate proposed chip-bonded photonic design, four RTX 6000 Ada/10 Gbps prototype, rented TPU measurements, and large-scale simulation.
Page 4 says TPU v3 then TPU v4; page 3 calls 64-chip rack a pod, conflicting with official 4096-chip Pod terminology; neither adopted as hardware specification.
Figure 8c shows reconfiguration finished/workload launched at 1.1 s, NCCL synchronized at 4.5 s, first iteration at 25.6 s; circuit replacement is not training recovery.
Simulated BERT/transformer hidden size 4096 does not make it a complete Llama model. ICI percentage penalties are modeling inputs, not measured universal contention losses.
Hardware table reports average epoch time while prose sometimes calls it iteration; different topology rows do not have identical measured speedups.
Appendix alpha-beta table is one ReduceScatter, not a full AllReduce; beta units must be time per byte.
Failure spares depend on SRG independence and time-availability assumptions; Pr(F>=K) condition is conservative for K spares versus exact Pr(F>K). No generic four-spare guarantee.
